title: Just your weekly reminder that Sara Bareilles is a genius #Broadway #...
transcript: Are there any musical theater lyrics that you think don't get enough appreciation? One lyric that I keep coming back to is from waitress, from the song What Baking Can Do. And it's when Jenna sings, make it up and surprise them. Tell them all my secrets, but disguise them so they dance on the tongues of the very people that their secrets from. I just think that is so beautiful and poetic. I love the imagery of dance on the tongues, and then to follow that up with, uh, from the very people that their secrets from. Like, it just flows together so beautifully, like, in the rhythm of it, you could almost feel the secrets dancing around and landing gently on that tongue. And obviously, there are so many beautiful lyrics in waitress. I think Sarah Bareilles is an incredible songwriter, and I love that she is writing musicals now. Like, I cannot wait for her new musical, The Interesting Things. It may be my most anticipated show of any of the new musicals currently in development. But of all the lyrics, that is the one that I keep coming back to, and it truly floors me every time I hear it. And I feel like no one talks about how brilliant it is.
classificationReason: General commentary discussing Sara Bareilles' lyrics from Waitress and anticipation for her upcoming musical. No first-hand production review and Waitress is not in the provided list.
